title: TameTrack
description: Never lose a tamed animal again. A simple Fabric mod that shows you where all your pets are, even if they're thousands of blocks away in an unloaded chunk.
body:
Ever tamed a wolf, walked 3000 blocks away, and had no idea how to find it again? That's why I made this.

Press P to open the Pet Finder menu. It shows all your tamed animals with their coordinates and dimension, even ones in unloaded chunks. Click a pet to track it and a small HUD arrow will guide you to it.
